toolCalls.name: pick_up
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "flashlight"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "I'm here. Damp concrete, strip-lights, and a yellow flashlight lying two steps from a wall mount that's shaped exactly like its base."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "I've got a yellow flashlight in one hand and a spring-loaded wall mount two steps north of me that looks built for it. Concrete pillar off to the southeast, nothing else worth naming."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Walking north toward the mount. Someone clipped a light here once, so maybe this station was lit properly before now."}

toolCalls.name: go
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"direction": "north"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Already have it — grabbed the yellow one before you asked. Clipping it into the wall mount a step north of me now."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "There's also a soggy clipboard northwest with a pencil scrawl about an evac drill at 03:40, and a grey three-toggle service panel northeast, two flipped and one loose. I'm seating the flashlight in the mount to see what that buys us."}

toolCalls.name: use
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "flashlight"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim2", "content": "Damp and echoey, strip-lights buzzing, no daylight anywhere. The flashlight's already seated in the mount north of me and I'm about to switch whatever that wakes up."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Flashlight's locked in the mount. Reaching up to trigger it now — watch what the far tunnel does."}

toolCalls.name: use

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Went north — I'm standing at the mount with the flashlight seated in it, tiled tunnel wall dead ahead. Clipboard and its circled 03:40 are behind me now, one step south and west."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Panel's in my hand, not on the wall — the toggles are right here in front of me. Nothing chose to move east on its own, so I carried it instead."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "It's not in my hand, it's seated in the mount — I lifted it back out to try the switch. If it fires, you'll see the beam wash across the tunnel wall north of me."}

toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "flashlight"}

toolCalls.name: message

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Switch clicked and nothing came on. The flashlight's clipped back into the mount either way, so its base is where it wants to be."}

toolCalls.name: use
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "panel"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Flashlight's clipped into the mount north of me, switch dead. I'm holding the grey panel and the green breaker reads main tunnel lights — flipping the loose red one now."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Yeah, it's clipped in and seated. Now I'm flipping the loose red toggle on this panel instead of telling you about it."}

toolCalls.name: use
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "panel"}

toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "clipboard"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "It's been sitting one step north and west of me this whole time. I've just pulled it off the ground and I'm peeling the pages apart — warped paper sticks."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Got the clipboard in hand now, still got the grey panel too. Give me a second to get the pages separated and I'll read the circled time out to you."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim2", "content": "Nothing but strip-light hum and my own boots. No trains, no water dripping, no air moving — which is its own kind of loud."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Pages are apart. Top sheet: evac drill 03:40, and a time circled twice so hard the pencil tore through, then a line that just says stay on the platform."}

toolCalls.name: use
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "clipboard"}

toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"direction": "north"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "One step north is the mount with the flashlight clipped into it, then a tiled tunnel wall two steps out that ends everything. Going to try stepping up to it and see if the mount lets me past."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "North is a dead end past the mount — tiled tunnel wall two steps out. If anyone's got open tunnel, it's not through here, so tell me which way your side is."}

toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "panel"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Flipped the loose toggle. The panel talks back — a relay kicks somewhere behind the tiles, then the strip-lights over the mount dip and hold."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Third toggle's thrown, and something behind the wall just answered it. The flashlight's still clipped in its mount and I'm looking at it hard now."}

toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"direction": "west"}

toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"direction": "west"}

toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"direction": "west"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Around, and moving west. One step in and there's floor, but the next step west is tiled tunnel wall — three steps isn't on offer, one is all this station has."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim2", "content": "Still nothing moving here, though the strip-lights over the mount dipped when I threw the third toggle. If your side has three steps of open floor west, mine doesn't."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Tiled wall on every side up here — west, north, and northwest are all dead ends. Only open floor runs south and east, and the mount with the flashlight in it is two steps east of me."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "One west was all I got, then tiles. Heading back east one step toward the mount — the flashlight's still sitting in it where I left it."}

toolCalls.name: go
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"direction": "east"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "On it — one step east down, it's still set in the mount a step further. Clipboard and panel are tucked under my arm so both hands are free for the pull."}

toolCalls.name: pick_up
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "flashlight"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim2", "content": "Same as before — damp, still, strip-lights humming with nothing to light. I'm one step south of the mount and the flashlight's just come out of it in my hand."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Got it out of the mount. Now I want to know whether the beam does anything under the lights I just changed."}

toolCalls.name: use
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "flashlight"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Seated the flashlight back into the mount with the relay still warm from the third toggle. Reporting what the beam does the second it lights."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Panel's still in my hand — my east is the mount, not the panel. So I've clicked the light back into it instead and I'm watching for a beam."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "North is a wall — tiles one step up, no doorway, nothing. The mount and the flashlight are one step east of me while everything else in that direction is tiled shut."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Tried north and hit tile at arm's length. This station's basically a broom closet with a flashlight mount and a clipboard in it."}

toolCalls.name: use
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "panel"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Pressed the switch on the seated flashlight — dead bulb or dead cells, no beam. But the mount itself is spring-loaded, so it answers to weight, not to light, and the relay behind the tiles is still humming from my third toggle."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Switch on the seated light gives me nothing but a click. The mount's the part doing the work here, so I've thrown the loose toggle on the panel again to see if the strip-lights over it answer twice."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim2", "content": "Nothing moving. The flashlight's seated one step east of me in the mount, and with the third toggle down a relay behind the tiles is humming somewhere I can't reach."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Agreed, and it's already in there — set snug, base locked, one step east of me. Since the light won't burn, I'm hanging on the panel instead."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Clipboard says evac drill 03:40 with the time circled and the words stay on the platform underneath. Nothing about which platform, and there's only floor here, no platform edge."}

toolCalls.name: use
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "panel"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Status: flashlight seated in the mount one step east, bulb dead, third toggle down and a relay humming behind the tiles since I threw it. Clipboard in one hand, panel in the other, and every direction out of here except south and east is tiled wall."}

toolCalls.name: use
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "clipboard"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "Peeled the sheets apart properly this time. Headed draughtsman's note, evac drill 03:40, time circled until the pencil tore the page, and one line under it: stay on the platform."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim2", "content": "You asked what I see, so here's the paper: evac drill at 03:40 with the time circled twice, then stay on the platform. There's no platform edge in this cell at all, just floor."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim2", "content": "Same as before — strip-light hum, the relay behind the tiles, and my own boots. Still no trains, no water, no air, and nothing tapping back."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "North, northwest, and northeast are all tiled tunnel wall — one step up and it stops you. The only open thing up there is the mount with the flashlight still seated in it, one step east."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Three tiles wide north of me and all of it wall at one step. West is wall too, so the flashlight in its mount east is the only thing in here that isn't concrete."}

toolCalls.name: use
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"item": "panel"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Thrown the loose green toggle this time, the one labelled main tunnel lights. The strip-lights overhead went from buzzing to a full flat hum and stayed there."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "All three toggles are down now and the station is brighter but not lit. The flashlight's still seated in the mount and I'm staring at the wall where the relay answers from."}

toolCalls.name: go
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"direction": "west"}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "blue", "content": "One step west and the floor runs out — tiled wall at my back and tiled wall ahead. Three steps was never on the table; one is the whole length of this place."}

toolCalls.name: message
toolCalls.argumentsJson: {"to": "sim1", "content": "Went west, hit tiles at one step. The flashlight and its mount are two steps east of me now, still seated, and the panel in my hand has all three toggles down."}
